correctness.rationale: For z=(w,s) in the doubled epigraph put H=s−|w|²/2. The vertical section through horizontal displacement a of the centered overlap has length 2H−|a|² for |a|<sqrt(2H). Radial integration yields precisely 2^(d/2+2)V_d H^((d+2)/2)/(d+2). Flattening the epigraph has Jacobian one and the gap at x+y is h+k+|u−v|²/2. Reintegrating the resulting horizontal kernel gives mass (d+2)/(4(h+k)). Minkowski and Young reduce the norm bound to Carleman on the positive half-line; its logarithmic Fourier multiplier pi/cosh(pi xi) has essential supremum pi and equals pi only on a null set. For sharpness, first dilate a normalized nonnegative horizontal bump at a fixed log plateau in height; its translated autocorrelations converge to one and are dominated by one, so the Rayleigh quotient tends to (d+2)/4 times the Carleman plateau quotient. Then widen the log plateau to attain the limit pi. The complex-input convolution inequality follows by domination and Tonelli, and Cauchy–Schwarz gives absolute existence of each convolution integral. Strictness for nonzero data follows from the strict Carleman norm bound. For d>=1 horizontal translations commute with the flattened operator and converge weakly to zero, so no compact subtractand reduces its norm. This independently verifies the constant, strict nonattainment, and the finite-rank obstruction.
residual_risks: The submitted finite quadratures only check normalizations and sample quotients; the continuum claims rely on the analytic reduction, sharpness sequence and translation proof.

value.rationale: The epigraph is a natural unbounded curved test domain for an existing weighted inequality. The exact all-dimensional best constant, absence of extremizers and the sharp compact-approximation obstruction answer quantitative questions that mere boundedness does not. There is a substantive reason to know the exact value and whether compact approximations can reduce the error.
residual_risks: No sharp-constant formula for arbitrary convex domains or non-isotropic domains has been established by this review.
